16. Between 1505 hours and 1520 hours, I deployed members for continuous firefighting at the external façades of Wang Cheong House and Wang Tai House and the open ground between Wang Cheong Court and Wang Tai Court. I also deployed members for assisting with evacuation from different buildings by redirecting evacuees to place of safety.

17. At about 1520 hours, a large amount of burning scaffolding structure, including bamboo, wooden planks, and miscellaneous articles, at the external wall of Wang Tai House facing the roundabout fell from height. These burning articles piled up and blocked the front entrance of Wang Tai House (i.e. at the east side of the block). At the same time, I instructed Turntable Ladder of Tai Po East Fire Station (“TPE/TL”), which was parked at the roundabout, to apply water monitor to Wang Cheong House and Wang Tai House on the side of the external wall facing the roundabout. I noted fire spread to Wang Shing House, its southwest façade (portion of middle to upper floors) was alight. As such, I also instructed TPE/TL to apply water monitor to Wang Shing House on its southwest façade facing the roundabout. The MP of Ma On Shan Fire Station (“MOS/MP”), which had been supplying water to TPE/TL, was damaged at about 1520 hours after its exhaust pipe was hit and damaged by falling debris from height of nearby buildings. As such, the water supply to TPE/TL was taken over by MP of Fanling Fire Station at about 1525 hours.

18. At 1519 hours, Assistant Divisional Officer CHEUNG Lok-hang (“ADO CHEUNG”) arrived at the scene and took on the role of Incident Commander.

[Question 7(b)]  
19. At about 1522 hours, I heard a Mayday message through radio telephone (“R/T”). The message stated: “Mayday, Mayday, Mayday, …………….. (i.e. the dots mean the words from the distressed member were muffled which I could not interpret) ，而家被困係 30 樓。”. I was only able to recognise the words “Mayday, Mayday, Mayday” and “而家被困係 30 樓”. I responded via R/T: “Mayday, Mayday, Mayday, 你喺咩位置。” However, I could not hear any response. At that time, I did not know the number and identity of the distressed member(s) nor his/their exact location. However, the fire at Wang Cheong House was extremely severe with heavy smoke. Since the fire originated at Wang Cheong House, I assessed that the distressed member(s) was/were most likely trapped on 30/F of Wang Cheong House.
